exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Did you have a favourite book when you were a child? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: How much reading do you do for your work/studies? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: What kinds of books do you read for pleasure? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 5
exercises.prompt: Do you prefer to read a newspaper or a magazine online, or to buy a copy? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a big city you would like to visit. You should say: which big city you would like to visit how you would travel there what you would do there and explain why you would like to visit this big city.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: What are the most interesting things to do while visiting cities on holiday?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Why can it be expensive to visit cities on holiday?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Do you think it is better to visit cities alone or in a group with friends?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Why have cities increased in size in recent years?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 7
exercises.prompt: What are the challenges created by ever-growing cities?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 8
exercises.prompt: In what ways do you think cities of the future will be different to cities today?
